Title: Create repository and add project docs
Acceptance criteria: A canonical source of truth exists; docs are version-controlled.

Title: Inventory current Figma pages and desktop notes
Acceptance criteria: Existing artifacts are linked and classified; no source is deleted.

Title: Choose first user and 3–5 core tasks
Acceptance criteria: Each task maps to a user problem and is testable.

Title: Set monthly AI/tools budget and usage log
Acceptance criteria: Provider caps and a spending review cadence exist.

Title: Create architecture decision records
Acceptance criteria: Base image, shell, toolkit, theming and privacy decisions are queued.

Title: Define token names and export strategy
Acceptance criteria: Color, type, spacing, radius, motion and state tokens are documented.

Title: Define icon grid and pilot icon set
Acceptance criteria: Pilot icons remain legible at target sizes and have provenance.

Title: Prototype core first-use and desktop flow
Acceptance criteria: Flow covers launch, window switching, system panel and settings.

Title: Run five usability sessions on clickable prototype
Acceptance criteria: Findings are recorded with severity and next action.

Title: Build repeatable Fedora-based VM image
Acceptance criteria: Clean build/boot succeeds using documented commands.

Title: Prototype shell on candidate compositor
Acceptance criteria: Input, focus, windows, popups and basic session behavior are demonstrated.

Title: Prototype Rust + GTK 4 shared component
Acceptance criteria: One app renders core tokens and passes keyboard/focus checks.

Title: Evaluate current system APIs for battery and storage
Acceptance criteria: Chosen APIs and failure/unknown states are documented.

Title: Test GTK, Qt, Electron and Flatpak appearance behavior
Acceptance criteria: A matrix records app versions, install method and observed theme behavior.

Title: Publish first architecture decision set
Acceptance criteria: ADRs have evidence, rationale, trade-offs and revisit triggers.

Title: Implement app launcher and window switching slice
Acceptance criteria: Core launch and switching tasks work in VM.

Title: Implement basic control surface and settings entry
Acceptance criteria: Panel states, keyboard behavior and errors are tested.

Title: Build one live-data system utility
Acceptance criteria: Shows valid data, unavailable state, permissions and refresh behavior.

Title: Add build and VM smoke-test instructions
Acceptance criteria: A clean checkout can reproduce build and test.

Title: Define installation and recovery strategy
Acceptance criteria: Install/update/rollback options are experimentally verified.

Title: Add accessibility pass to core flows
Acceptance criteria: Keyboard-only, focus, text scale, contrast and reduced-motion checks recorded.

Title: Create security and dependency inventory
Acceptance criteria: Shipped components, licences, update sources and report path are documented.

Title: Create static website progress and docs pages
Acceptance criteria: Site communicates project maturity accurately and links source/known issues.

Title: Create beta tester guide and issue templates
Acceptance criteria: Testers know install risk, supported hardware, feedback and privacy expectations.

Title: Establish release checklist and changelog
Acceptance criteria: A preview release can pass documented gates and link to release notes.

Title: Benchmark boot, memory and battery on reference hardware
Acceptance criteria: Conditions and baseline are recorded and repeatable.
